info.name: SpeakIT API
info.description:
# SpeakIT Production API Collection

Official Postman Collection for SpeakIT SaaS — AI Voice Generation (TTS) & Speech-to-Text (STT) Platform.

## Authentication Flow
1. **Register**: `POST /api/auth/register` initiates user registration with username, email, phone, and password.
2. **Verify Email**: `POST /api/auth/verify-email` verifies the OTP sent to email and returns the initial JWT `token`.
3. **Login**: `POST /api/auth/login` returns a JWT `token`. The test script automatically stores this in the `{{token}}` variable.
4. **Authenticated Requests**: All protected endpoints use Bearer Token auth (`{{token}}`).
5. **WebSocket Session**: `POST /api/auth/ws-ticket` issues a single-use ticket for secure WebSocket handshakes (`/ws/logout`).

## Environment Variables
- `baseUrl`: The root HTTP URL of the backend (Default: `http://localhost:8080`)
- `wsUrl`: The root WebSocket URL of the backend (Default: `ws://localhost:8080`)
- `token`: The active JWT Bearer token (populated automatically on Login/Verify Email)
- `ticket`: Single-use ticket for WebSocket connections (populated automatically on Issue WS Ticket)

## Included Domains
- Authentication & Account Lifecycles
- User Profile & Security Management
- Text-to-Speech (TTS - AWS Polly, ElevenLabs, Sarvam AI)
- Speech-to-Text & Translation (STT)
- TTS History & Analytics
- Billing & Razorpay Subscriptions
- Webhooks (Razorpay event handler)
- Contact & Enterprise Inquiries
- System Parameters (Whitelist-protected dynamic feature flags)
- WebSocket Real-Time Invalidation

request.description:
Public contact form submission endpoint with defense-in-depth security:
1. Telegram Bot Integration: Dispatches real-time alerts to the administrative Telegram channel via TelegramService (MarkdownV2 escaping, 5-second read timeout, up to 3 total attempts with 1s and 2s delays).
2. Bot Protection: Invisible honeypot field ('website') silently rejects automated bot submissions.
3. Replay Protection: Validates 'X-Request-ID' header against a 5-minute atomic in-memory cache to guarantee idempotency.
4. Anti-Spam Deduplication: SHA-256 message fingerprinting suppresses duplicate submissions from the same sender within 60 seconds.
5. Privacy Compliance: Client IP is hashed using SHA-256 before persisting to PostgreSQL ('contact_submissions').
6. Supported Topics: 'support' (Technical Support), 'billing' (Billing), 'feature' (Feature Request), 'general' (General Inquiry), 'enterprise' (Enterprise / Partnership), 'feedback' (Feedback).
